tools.name: castle_get_events_schema
tools.description: List the event fields you can filter and group on, with their types. Read this first — the other query tools need real field names. Castle: GET /v1/events/schema.

tools.name: castle_search_events
tools.description: Query the security event stream — logins, registrations, transactions and their risk verdicts. Read-only despite being a POST: Castle takes the query in the body. Castle: POST /v1/events/query.

tools.name: castle_group_events
tools.description: Aggregate matching events by one or more fields — the fast way to see which IPs, devices or countries dominate a spike. Read-only despite being a POST. Castle: POST /v1/events/group.

tools.name: castle_search_lists
tools.description: Find the allow/deny lists defined in the environment. Read-only despite being a POST. Castle: POST /v1/lists/query.

tools.name: castle_get_list
tools.description: Fetch a single list with its primary and secondary field definitions. Castle: GET /v1/lists/{id}.

tools.name: castle_search_list_items
tools.description: Search the entries of one list — the blocked IPs, emails or device ids it holds. Read-only despite being a POST. Castle: POST /v1/lists/{list_id}/items/query.

tools.name: castle_count_list_items
tools.description: Count the entries in one list, with the same optional filters as the search. Read-only despite being a POST. Castle: POST /v1/lists/{list_id}/items/count.

tools.name: castle_get_list_item
tools.description: Fetch a single list entry — its value, who added it, the comment and its archive time. Castle: GET /v1/lists/{list_id}/items/{id}.

tools.name: castle_create_list
tools.description: Create a new allow or deny list. primary_field is the event field its entries match on, e.g. ip or user.email. Castle: POST /v1/lists.

tools.name: castle_update_list
tools.description: Rename a list or change its colour or description. Castle: PUT /v1/lists/{id}.

tools.name: castle_create_list_item
tools.description: Add an entry to a list — for example block an IP or an email. This changes live policy behaviour. Castle: POST /v1/lists/{list_id}/items.

tools.name: castle_update_list_item
tools.description: Change the comment on a list entry. Castle: PUT /v1/lists/{list_id}/items/{id}.

tools.name: castle_archive_list_item
tools.description: Archive a list entry so it stops matching. Reversible with castle_unarchive_list_item. Castle: DELETE /v1/lists/{list_id}/items/{id}/archive.

tools.name: castle_unarchive_list_item
tools.description: Restore a previously archived list entry so it matches again. Castle: PUT /v1/lists/{list_id}/items/{id}/unarchive.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: castle_search_events, castle_group_events, castle_search_lists, castle_search_list_items, castle_count_list_items, castle_get_list_item, castle_create_list, castle_create_list_item, castle_update_list_item · Public sink: castle_search_events, castle_group_events, castle_search_lists, castle_search_list_items, castle_count_list_items, castle_create_list, castle_create_list_item · Destructive: castle_archive_list_item.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: castle_search_events, castle_group_events, castle_search_lists, castle_search_list_items, castle_count_list_items, castle_get_list_item, castle_create_list, castle_create_list_item, castle_update_list_item · Public sink: castle_search_events, castle_group_events, castle_search_lists, castle_search_list_items, castle_count_list_items, castle_create_list, castle_create_list_item · Destructive: castle_archive_list_item

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
